WITH store_sks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
),
filtered_customers AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, i_item_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    JOIN store ON customer_demographics.cd_customer_sk = store.c_customer_sk
    WHERE customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'M' AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Secondary' AND store.s_year = 1999
),
filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT ss_quantity, ss_list_price, ss_coupon_amt, ss_sales_price, ss_store_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_customers ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = filtered_customers.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
)
SELECT i_item_id, s_state, GROUPING(s_state) AS g_state, AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM filtered_sales JOIN store ON filtered_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim ON store.s_rec_start_date = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
WHERE store.s_store_sk IN (store_sks.s_store_sk)
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, s_state)
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state LIMIT 100
